candidates: When implementing AST-based detection of whether a package is already imported in code parsed with `@babel/parser` (via this project's `babelParse` utility), use `traverse` to walk the full AST and check for both static `ImportDeclaration` nodes (via `path.node.source.value`) and dynamic `import()` expressions — which `@babel/parser` represents as `CallExpression` nodes with `t.isImport(path.node.callee)`, NOT as `ImportExpression` nodes (that representation belongs to `@babel/eslint-parser`). Tools like `eslint-flat-config-utils` commonly use dynamic imports, so omitting the `CallExpression` check produces false negatives.
